Welcome to the integrated battery mod recommendation megathread! IB mods are things like MVPs, iSticks, and all that jazz.

The Rules

All parent comments must be in the following format:

 Manufacturer |Mod Name |Price Range |Review Link
---------|----------

* Discussions on why you personally recommend it

So it ends up looking like:

Innokin Coolfire IV $37.95 Review

Moderator's note: If a published written or video review is not trustworthy (e.g. super shilly, contains no real information, etc.), then a link to something like an ECF thread is acceptable. All the better if it has pictures. Trustworthiness of reviews will be decided by the mods.

  • I would recommend the Coolfire IV because it fires up to 40W, fires way down to 0.3 ohms, has really good battery life even though it says "only" 2000mAh. You can flip the screen, and it has a master on/off switch in case you're paranoid like me for traveling. Looks pretty snazzy as well.

Any questions, additional reviews or information regarding the tanks should take place in response to the parent comment.

All discussions of sales, additional reviews, pricing, etc. will be posted in response to the original piece of gear. Double posts will be deleted.

Feel free to link to reviews that have been posted on /v/vaping already as part of the post.

Rules will be updated as needed.

But /u/NewFatMike, why is this thing?

Until we have a wiki capacity, this will be a useful tool to come to for new gear reviews. Furthermore, it will be good to have a running record of what gear is out there. This thread will be useful because it will let us see more novel and new gear for the people who want to see it and provide a wealth of information for people coming in late to learn everything they want in discussion about the piece of gear in question.

Go forth, vaping lovelies, and recommend!
